description: Fixture public tours for the chatbot offline evaluation (#189). Each entry of `tours` is a tour.published payload; `topics` is the topic assignment the indexer would get from the topic extractor.

tours.title: Hanoi street food walk
tours.description: Taste pho, bun cha and snacks at the street food stalls of the Old Quarter in Hanoi.

places.name: Bat Dan pho stall
places.description: Family beef pho noodle soup stall, queue in the early morning.

places.name: Bun cha Huong Lien
places.description: Grilled pork with rice noodles, a classic Hanoi lunch dish.

places.name: Dong Xuan market
places.description: Old covered market with food stalls and local snacks.

tours.title: Hành trình lịch sử Hà Nội
tours.description: Đi bộ qua đền, Văn Miếu và bảo tàng để tìm hiểu lịch sử nghìn năm của Hà Nội.

places.name: Đền Ngọc Sơn
places.description: Ngôi đền trên hồ Hoàn Kiếm, nối với bờ bằng cầu Thê Húc.

translations.text: Ngoc Son temple on Hoan Kiem lake, reached by the red Huc bridge.

places.name: Văn Miếu Quốc Tử Giám
places.description: Văn Miếu, trường đại học đầu tiên của Việt Nam, xây năm 1070.

translations.text: Temple of Literature, the first university of Vietnam, built in 1070.

places.name: Bảo tàng Lịch sử Quốc gia
places.description: Bảo tàng lịch sử Việt Nam trong tòa nhà kiến trúc Đông Dương.

tours.title: Hanoi French architecture by bike
tours.description: Cycle past French colonial architecture: the opera house, the cathedral and the Long Bien bridge in Hanoi.

places.name: Hanoi Opera House
places.description: French colonial opera house built in 1911, neoclassical architecture.

places.name: St Joseph Cathedral
places.description: Neo-gothic church from 1886 with twin bell towers.

places.name: Long Bien bridge
places.description: Steel cantilever bridge over the Red River, built 1899 to 1902.

tours.title: Ẩm thực đường phố Sài Gòn
tours.description: Đi bộ thưởng thức cơm tấm, bánh mì và món ăn đường phố quanh chợ Bến Thành, Sài Gòn.

places.name: Chợ Bến Thành
places.description: Chợ Bến Thành, khu chợ lâu đời với nhiều quầy món ăn.

translations.text: Ben Thanh market, historic market with many food stalls.

places.name: Quán cơm tấm Ba Ghiền
places.description: Cơm tấm sườn nướng nổi tiếng của Sài Gòn.

places.name: Bánh mì Huỳnh Hoa
places.description: Tiệm bánh mì đầy pate và thịt nguội, luôn đông khách.

tours.title: Saigon history and colonial buildings
tours.description: Walk through the history of Saigon: Independence Palace, the Central Post Office and Notre Dame cathedral in Ho Chi Minh City.

places.name: Independence Palace
places.description: Historic palace where the war ended in 1975, 1960s modernist architecture.

places.name: Saigon Central Post Office
places.description: Central Post Office from the French colonial era, designed in the 1880s.

places.name: Notre Dame Cathedral Saigon
places.description: Red brick cathedral built between 1863 and 1880.

tours.title: Green Saigon cycling loop
tours.description: Cycle between parks, gardens and the river: the green side of nature in Ho Chi Minh City.

places.name: Tao Dan park
places.description: Large shady park with old trees and a bird cafe.

places.name: Saigon Zoo and Botanical Garden
places.description: Botanical garden from 1864 with tropical plants.

places.name: Bach Dang river park
places.description: Riverside park along the Saigon river, best at sunset.

tours.title: Phố cổ Hội An
tours.description: Đi bộ khám phá kiến trúc và di sản phố cổ Hội An: Chùa Cầu, nhà cổ và hội quán.

places.name: Chùa Cầu
places.description: Chùa Cầu do thương nhân Nhật Bản xây thế kỷ 17, biểu tượng của Hội An.

translations.text: Japanese Covered Bridge built by Japanese merchants in the 17th century, symbol of Hoi An.

places.name: Nhà cổ Tấn Ký
places.description: Nhà cổ hơn 200 năm với kiến trúc gỗ Việt, Hoa, Nhật.

translations.text: Tan Ky old house, over 200 years old, wooden architecture.

places.name: Hội quán Phúc Kiến
places.description: Hội quán của người Hoa với cổng tam quan rực rỡ.

tours.title: Hoi An food trail
tours.description: Eat cao lau, banh mi and white rose dumplings: a food walk through Hoi An.

places.name: Cao lau noodle shop
places.description: Cao lau, the local noodle dish of Hoi An, with pork and greens.

places.name: Banh Mi Phuong
places.description: Famous banh mi sandwich shop.

places.name: Hoi An central market
places.description: Central market with food stalls by the river.

tours.title: Hoi An countryside and beach ride
tours.description: Cycle through rice fields, a coconut forest and An Bang beach: nature around Hoi An.

places.name: Tra Que vegetable village
places.description: Herb gardens and rice fields of an organic farming village.

places.name: An Bang beach
places.description: Quiet sandy beach with seafood restaurants.

places.name: Bay Mau coconut forest
places.description: Coconut forest with basket boat rides on the water.
